title: Where Billy McFarland Is Now: Prison, Fyre Festival 2 and a $245,300 eBay Sale

lines.say: Billy McFarland got six years for the Fyre fraud and a ticket scam he ran on bail.
lines.show: Billy McFarland got six years for the Fyre fraud and a ticket scam he ran on bail.

lines.say: Hunting for assets, the FBI listed two large boxes of Fyre-branded clothing.
In prison, the government said, he was caught with a pen that could record, and spent forty days segregated.
lines.show: In prison, the government said, he was caught with a pen that could record, and spent 40 days segregated.

lines.say: According to NPR, he was released in two thousand twenty-two. In two thousand twenty-five, Fyre Festival two was postponed.
lines.show: According to NPR, he was released in 2022. In 2025, Fyre Festival 2 was postponed.

lines.say: In July two thousand twenty-five, the Fyre brand sold on eBay for two hundred forty-five thousand, three hundred dollars.
lines.show: In July 2025, the Fyre brand sold on eBay for $245,300.

lines.say: NPR reports he still owes twenty-six million dollars in restitution.
lines.show: NPR reports he still owes $26 million in restitution.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
